tasks.title: End-to-end accessibility gate
tasks.original_scope: Assemble real output accessibility checks across visual, motion, narration, caption and game controls with explicit applicability.
required_closure_evidence: Keyboard/focus, color-independent meaning, readable labels and captions have failing controls.
Reduced-motion and flash checks cover actual output, not only the plan.
No blanket conformance certificate from static style metadata.
tasks.implemented_local: Actual-output accessibility evidence aggregation and static keyboard/focus capture. Exact required viewports/controls/caption/meaning inventories, byte/time bindings and unmeasured-axis review.
remaining: Native final audiovisual and game output, screen-reader/focus behavior, actual caption paint and motion/flash coverage remain open.
Static desktop keyboard fixtures are not WCAG conformance, physical-device support, whole-film flash analysis or clinical certification.

tasks.title: Native source-extraction repair adapter
tasks.original_scope: Repair derived extraction/anchors through approved native providers while preserving original bytes and meaning.
required_closure_evidence: Multiregion/scanned defects generate bounded proposals with unchanged original sources.
Ambiguous extraction escalates rather than fabricating a quote.
Every repaired source change invalidates downstream meaning/media evidence.
tasks.implemented_local: Reruns the native PDF ingestion/provenance adapter and proposes a regenerated multi-region derived snapshot; original source bytes and extraction policy remain unchanged. Actual source-pixel/text verification is repeated.
remaining: Scanned repair with independently valid OCR and reading-order/figure interpretation remains open; no OCR process was executed in this batch.
Only proposed derived extraction is produced; semantic assessment, canonical downstream invalidation/adoption and real-book proof remain required.

tasks.title: Contextual reasoning/pedagogy/director repair
tasks.original_scope: Use governed generators to propose semantic corrections without inventing facts or weakening teaching objectives; preserve provenance.
required_closure_evidence: Incorrect proposed corrections are rejected by independent validators.
New assessments bind changed content; old signatures cannot approve new proposals.
Bounded budgets and human escalation prevent unending or silent rewrite loops.
tasks.implemented_local: Executes a pinned trusted contextual-generator callback with bounded output/deadline and preserves source links, objective identities, conditions and record inventory. Separate fresh approval and unchanged repair-controller validation are required.
remaining: Positive callbacks and signing credentials are authored synthetic diagnostics; no live authorized model or independent semantic assessor was executed.
Preservation of declared conditions is not proof that new prose is true or pedagogically effective. Native content schemas and full runtime repair need owner-reviewed integration.

tasks.title: Native generated-code and game repair integration
tasks.original_scope: Apply owner-scoped repairs to actual generated modules using approved templates/transformations rather than claiming universal code repair.
required_closure_evidence: Compile and native runtime validation are required after repair.
Defects outside the supported transformation set escalate with intact originals.
tasks.implemented_local: Owner/recipe/SceneIR/emitter-bound complete JSON-literal slot transformations in explicitly generated TypeScript const-data modules. Protects all other bytes and requires compile/native-runtime/regression check scope before controller handoff.
remaining: This is a restricted data-module adapter, not arbitrary TypeScript/React/game-interface repair. Unsupported module grammar or handwritten functions escalate.
Actual TypeScript and Node diagnostics ran, but native BIE generated application repair, full rebuild and native-origin runtime did not; H5 native runtime gates remain open.

tasks.title: Durable orchestration and crash recovery
tasks.original_scope: Bind local journals to canonical task invalidation/idempotency and durable transactional state.
required_closure_evidence: Crash/resume, duplicate delivery and competing reservations cannot double-publish or reset budgets.
Cancellation/timeouts terminate whole registered process groups and preserve evidence.
Distributed recovery is explicitly tested when that deployment is enabled.
tasks.implemented_local: Transactional local SQLite lease/fencing/attempt budgets, hash-chained state projection and result/invalidation outbox; committed-claim crash recovery and competing processes exercised. Native invalidation contract executes on exact causal descendant sets.
remaining: Local trusted-directory durability, not distributed deployment, trusted wall-clock service, adversarial DB administration/rollback defense or exactly-once remote publication.

Lease expiry does not terminate the old worker. Fencing prevents stale commits; worker process-group cancellation is separate and only trusted callbacks are supported. Canonical orchestrator dispatch remains open.

tasks.title: Canonical regression corpus and test identity
tasks.original_scope: Register full canonical cases, immutable expected outputs and suite-qualified identities; run all native consumers, not only the local subset.
required_closure_evidence: Missing cases, altered fixtures and duplicate record identities fail.
Before/after semantic, pixel and game-state regressions include negative controls.
The 3529 local cases are not relabelled as full-repository coverage.
tasks.implemented_local: Checks a supplied Git checkout against independently pinned revision/tree and every raw tracked blob, rejects dirty/untracked/omitted test files, discovers suite-qualified cases, and executes the independently approved immutable registration in isolated processes.
remaining: Only two authored two-test Git repositories exercised full discovery/execution; the full Enterprise-bie checkout is not mounted and was explicitly rejected rather than substituted.

The cumulative local suite count is not canonical regression coverage. Broader frameworks, third-party dependency closure, production worker isolation and latest canonical corpus execution remain open.
